school1.description: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at Bina Nusantara University with a specialization in Artificial Inteligence (AI). My studies focus on fundamental computer science concepts such as algorithms, data structures, and mathematics while also exploring some AI concepts and and developing practical experience in software, application and web development through academic project and personal projects.

contribution.1: Contribute to the development and improvement of an application or website by implementing new features on both the frontend and backend.
contribution.2: Improving the quality of the user interface and user experience (UI/UX) to create an engaging and responsive user experiences.
contribution.3: Making some adjustment to the flow and logic of the app to make it more consistent and easier for users to understand.
contribution.4: Identify, analyze, and resolve issues in applications and websites to improve system performance and stability.

project_1.description: Developed a company profile website for INTI (Indotama Teknologi Inovasi) that aimed on introducing the company's identity, services, and several AI-based products/solutions in a modern way.

project_2.description: InCustoms is a product from INTI (Indotama Teknologi Inovasi) which designed to assist the extraction and processing of data that contained in documents to improve business operational efficiency.

project_3.description: InMeterai is a product of INTI (Indotama Teknologi Inovasi) which is a digital e-stamping platform that enables users to purchase and apply electronic stamps (e-meterai) to their legal documents.

project_4.description: CuyKerja is a job portal website designed to connect job seekers with employers, allowing users to search for job opportunities and post vacancies to find suitable candidates.
